caveats: Sector summaries span alignment/acquisition, not continuous ADC waveforms; closed-loop run has aggregate counts and the separate 16-trial summary.
Forward/reverse crossings refer to observed voltage crossing the expected Schmitt band, NOT measured rotor direction.
ADC ranks are sequential software-consumed samples. Filtered current is not peak phase current. Duty_first is boundary value; duty_last is last sampled output.
Record/counter overflow and phase mismatch are explicit flags. Actual logger overhead needs on-board cycle maxima; offline tests do not validate timing.
Both banks pin first completed failure and first full 1-second closed-loop observation. Operator early-zero does not pin. No motor actions originate in the logger.
Last 16 summaries. Paired acquisition banks separately retain first completed failure and first full closed-loop observation. Early operator zero does not pin a bank.
Observed times are service timestamps, not physical zero-cross timestamps. Current is a filtered software maximum, not peak phase current.
S2: acquisition <= 300 ms; only six-edge handoff earns <= 1 s observation; first runtime timeout aborts. Not a hardware current limiter, native stuck-trip proof or flight mode.
